messages:
maria: heads-up — onboarding CLI sampleapp can drop request/context IDs at debug log level, saw raw user email in stdout :grimacing:

alex: repro steps? can you paste a quick sequence so I can try locally

maria: steps that hit it for me:
1) git clone github.com/redwood/sampleapp
2) cd sampleapp && export REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug && export NODE_ENV=development
3) ./scripts/onboard.sh --simulate-user=1
4) curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'

logs:```
[DEBUG] initializing logger (no reqid attached)
POST /generate 200 - payload: {"email":"alice@example.com","prompt":"hi"}
[DEBUG] response sent (reqid=null)
```

dev-bot: Incident 2423456789 created — telemetry-redact-failure

sam: interesting — sounds like OTEL autoinit is happening after the logger attaches scrubbing hooks, so scrub runs without request-id context and skips redaction on some lines

kevin: which SDK version? and is this Node or Python sample?

maria: Node, redwood-js-sdk v0.9.3 (installed by quickstart). attaching the boot sequence I used:
```js
// index.js (sampleapp)
const logger = require('./lib/logger'); // auto-attach scrub hook
const redwood = require('redwood-sdk').init(); // triggers autoinit for OTEL
// rest of app
```

alex: quick local workaround: export REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_INIT=early before running; that forces OTEL init before logger and I can reproduce fix locally

maria: confirmed — setting REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_INIT=early restores reqid in debug logs :tada:

sam: i'll open a PR to change SDK autoinit ordering so OTEL/ctx propagation is initialized earlier by default and add a guard in logger scrub to wait for ctx attach. will also add an e2e for onboarding CLI

maria: pls also add a short note in the onboarding README for now about REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_INIT workaround so customers hitting this get unblocked

deploy-bot: PR #4532 queued for CI (sam/telemetry-autoinit-order)

kevin: good catch — also flag mobile and python sampleapps for the same pattern, might be cross-SDK issue

maria: will double-check mobile sampleapp, thanks everyone
